title: Description of various locations and hubs in my world. Do these feel familiar to anyone?
content: I’m going to work on mapping, drawing, and describing what I have always referred to as my dream world. I’m going to include the “hubs” that align with the mall world. But I’ve also written extensively about more personal places (childhood home, grandparents houses, in between places) which I may also post someday if it seems relevant. Toilet hub Usually in school sometimes in mall world or hotel world. Dirty, enormous, disgustingly filthy, no doors, broken everything, people walking in on you, weird showers almost like a dirty locker room but no curtains or privacy, no or soaking wet toilet paper, broken sinks spraying water, used menstrual products, dirty diapers, just gross everywhere but it’s the only bathroom available. All genders. Slimy, smelly. Weird shaped toilets, toilets in hot tubs and bath tubs. Mall World (Main Hub) Strangely I’m not sure where this is. I don’t feel like I ever travel there I just pop into the mall. It’s always shifting but the basics are the same. Retro vibes, either packed or very few people. It definitely has similarities to my childhood mall. Big movie theater. There’s an arcade, kids stores, lots of fancy stores where I can never find anything. There’s a target/kohl’s type area that is really normal except there’s a weird creepy area with old stuff. Tons of liminal spaces. There is a version of Trader Joe’s or a grocery store. Big food court, lots of food and candy stores. Stores like Claire’s, JCPenney. There are tunnels and multiple levels. It seems to be connected via an underground hall to the transportation hub which connects to the hotel world and other locations. It is scarier as you go underground. Parts of it seem dated and others super futuristic. There’s really only one spot where I can leave and when I exit I am in a massive abandoned parking lot surrounded by wooded areas. Hotel world There is a massive old hotel with elevators that act crazy and barely work. Always scary getting in one. There are offshoots, ski lifts, and tunnels to other buildings. There are areas that are really scary and remind me of the shining. Rooms are usually not remarkable. Huge bar/club/dining area and casino. There are humongous staircases and escalators. Easy to get lost, feels like a maze a lot of the time. Seemingly unending. You can explore and find rooms that look straight from 100 years ago and haven’t changed. You can stumble into business meetings, parties. There is an indoor pool with slides that is always hot, steamy, and chaotic. Outside of the hotel you can easily travel to the city although it is still very unfamiliar after all of this time. Transportation hub Combo of airport and train. Outside of the City. Almost always take planes. TSA is confusing but not such a pain. Planes tend to crash or be impossibly big with restaurants and stores. Strangely I can make my way into the baggage area under the plane which feels super dangerous. If I am lucid enough, I can access it via the mall and travel to other countries. The museum Possibly connected to universal/amusement park. There is a large wildlife exhibit and aquarium. There is also an exhibit that is interactive and looks doctor Seuss themed, like wild children’s museum or educational center. Super trippy. Lots of climbing. Sometimes there is a scary ride that is set up much like a movie theater. A lot of times there’s an imax theater as well. The City Still “new” to me. It feels chaotic and confusing. Usually end up in a scary driving situation or car accident involving a bridge or overpass. Multiple dreams where I’m abandoned at the football stadium outside of town. The farmer’s market and other familiar areas exist but again are different and very confusing to what is in real life. One coffee shop seems to pop up often. The coffee shop area has a restaurant I walk to often. There's a made up neighborhood in midtown with shops, ethnic food, my favorite coffee and lunch spot in the city. There’s also a scary road to get out of town toward the airport. Very large unfamiliar sprawl. College town Usually on campus or in the dorms but I can never find my room or anyone I know. I sit in on classes I don't belong to and have very stressful school related experiences. Often I have “drunk” party dreams there where I end up unsafe or terrified. There’s a familiar apartment area where I tend to live. There are some restaurants and a farmers market like area I enjoy but other than that it’s just bad. I work at Grocery store and go there often. Lots of stress free driving thankfully. University has evolved. Often very futuristic. There are spots where I smoke and wait for the bus. Similar to the college I attended but WAY nicer and very pretty. Buildings are huge and modern/futuristic. Library is probably the most familiar, yet I seem to always get lost. I end up wandering into lectures or private meetings. Biggest stresses are my grade and missing classes/going to the wrong classes. “Las Vegas” It isn’t Vegas, that’s just what my brain calls it. Weird beach town with multiple casinos. Multi colored beach houses. There’s a theme park with massive roller coasters. There are dangerous beaches often with animals like polar bears and crocodiles. They are almost completely unreachable. Cruise ships are extremely dangerous labyrinths that almost always capsize. There are many private beaches and pools I try to sneak into often. Always a lot of people. Looks very idyllic, a lot like Miami in many ways (though I’ve never been IRL). Pretty lake The favorite location. The name was dubbed by my brain in my childhood. It’s been there for maybe 18 years. A beautiful and sprawling park where I often camp and fish. There is a beach near and a lazy river. It’s beautiful. It is near what I call snow mountain which is basically sledding down a crazy mountain. It never feels dangerous, always fun and safe. Animal farm Again, it’s just called that for whatever reason. In the country right behind my childhood house. There are stables filled with various and often abused farm animals. Tornadoes in the area. Sometimes there’s a gathering house for parties that has a pool. It’s sketchy and kind of gross. There’s a huge, hilly cemetery nearby. Childhood house and high school Both seem to be connected. Mom and dad are basically evil most of the time. My sister (who passed young IRL) is usually there as well. Parents act weird and intrusive. Alcohol seems to always be involved. Day and night always seem to get mixed up. Sometimes there is a horse or animal in the back. Quite often I can fly from the backyard, from a very specific “launch” spot. Often the entire backyard is a giant gross swimming pool. Many times I’m trying to have a party. Something always goes wrong. There are often weather and space anomalies. Comets, tornados, moon exploding, nuclear warfare. The basement itself seems to be a hub where we all take shelter from these events. I always survive if I’m there. If I’m outside of the home, I’ll die. There’s multiple blocks of the neighborhood that I know well. I often break into the neighbors houses and explore. The drive outside of town A small made up town exists if you drive west from my hometown. It is familiar but hard to describe. It pops up often. Weirdly I know the exact route in my mind and all of the streets, particularly one road. I pass by familiar factories and a gas station on the way. I randomly attend school and other events there. Universal/Theme Park Theme park with crazy and dangerous rides. Often water rides. Ever changing aside from the fact that Harry Potter world has always been way too far away and is still unreachable. It’s always a crazy long walk or something about it is wrong once I get there. Sometimes we have to choose between going to a water park or normal rides, still can never make it to hogwarts. There is also a water park and zoo type place I visit often with friends. It’s strangely stressful. Wasteland Outside of Hometown, down a long and winding road, there’s a wasteland with animal carcasses everywhere. Roads are unkept and dangerous. Tornadoes often in the area but not close enough to be dangerous.
